CameraConfig.description:
The camera model a workflow calibrates, and which of its parameters stay
fixed.

The model names one kind per slot — projection, distortion and sensor —
so a tilted (Scheimpflug) sensor is a value of `model.sensor`, not a
separate workflow. Behaviour that depends on the sensor (default fix
lists, the linear stage's tangential terms, the tilt multi-start) follows
from the model.

fix.description:
Parameters held fixed during the non-linear solve, named per slot
(`{"intrinsics": ["cx", "cy"], "distortion": ["k3"], "sensor":
["tilt_y"]}`). A slot left out keeps the model's default: `k3` for
Brown-Conrady, and everything but the low-order radial terms (`k1`,
`k2`; the division model's `lambda`) under a Scheimpflug sensor,
because tangential and higher-order terms trade off against the tilt.
An unknown name is a configuration error.

model.description:
The camera model, one kind per slot. Default: pinhole projection,
Brown-Conrady (`k1, k2, k3, p1, p2`) distortion and an identity
(untilted) sensor — the model every workflow accepts.

CameraFix.description:
Camera parameters held fixed during a solve, named per slot.

Each list names parameters of the model in that slot (`fx`, `cy`, `k3`,
`tilt_y`, …). `None` means the model's default
([`CameraModelSpec::default_fix`]); an empty list fixes nothing in that
slot. Names are checked against the model by [`CameraFix::resolve`], before
any work.

distortion.description:
Fixed distortion coefficients; default: `k3` for Brown-Conrady, and
everything but the low-order radial terms under a Scheimpflug sensor.

CameraModelSpec.description:
A camera model: the kind in each slot. The values live in
[`CameraParams`](super::CameraParams); [`CameraParams::spec`](super::CameraParams::spec)
recovers the spec from them.

DistortionKind.description:
Which distortion model a camera carries.

`dim() == 0` means the camera has no distortion parameter block.

oneOf.description: Rational polynomial `[k1, k2, k3, k4, k5, k6, p1, p2]`.
Brown-Conrady + thin-prism `[k1, k2, k3, p1, p2, s1, s2, s3, s4]`.

Kannala-Brandt radial polynomial `[k1, k2, k3, k4]`; with
[`ProjectionKind::Equidistant`] the Kannala-Brandt fisheye model.

FoldScore.description: One fold of a candidate's score.

converged.description:
Whether every solve of the fold (the fit and each held-out pose)
stopped by a convergence rule rather than at its iteration budget.

held_out_points.description: Held-out points that project, the count behind `held_out_rms_px`.

held_out_rms_px.description: The RMS of the fold's held-out views, pixels.

training_rms_px.description: The RMS of the fold's fit on its own training views, pixels.

HeldOutScore.description:
A candidate's reprojection error on the views it was fitted to and on
the views it was not. All errors are Euclidean pixel distances.

delta_se_px.description:
The standard error of `delta_vs_best_px`, paired by fold: the sample
standard deviation over the folds of this candidate's held-out RMS
minus the best's, divided by `√K`, pixels (≥ 0). The candidates see
the same folds, so the shared view-to-view variation cancels.

delta_vs_best_px.description:
This candidate's pooled held-out RMS minus that of the best ranked
candidate (`ranking[0]`), pixels; 0 for the best itself and when no
candidate is ranked.

fold_scatter_px.description:
The sample standard deviation of the folds' held-out RMS, pixels
(≥ 0): how much the score moves with the views a fit sees.

folds.description: One entry per fold, in fold order.

held_out.description:
Pooled over the folds: each view scored once, by the fit of the fold
that held it out, pixels. `count` excludes points that do not
project.

per_view_rms_px.description:
The held-out RMS of each view, pixels, by view index; 0 for a view
none of whose points project.

training.description:
The fit to all views, on those views (in-sample), pixels. It only
falls as the model grows; it does not rank models.

unprojected_points.description:
Held-out points that do not project through the fold's camera at
the solved pose. A candidate with any is listed but not ranked: its
score covers fewer points than the others'.

oneOf.description: Every fit and every held-out pose solve succeeded.

A fit or a held-out pose solve failed; the other candidates are still
scored.

fold.description:
The fold whose fit or held-out view failed; `None` for the fit to
all views.

ModelScore.description: One candidate camera configuration and how it scored.

camera.description: The candidate: the camera model and its fixed parameters.

free_parameters.description:
The camera parameters the candidate's fit estimates: its intrinsics,
projection, distortion and sensor parameters minus those its fix
lists (or the model's default fix list) hold fixed. Not the model's
slot count: Brown-Conrady with `k3` fixed has 8.

outcome.description: The held-out score, or why the candidate could not be scored.

ProjectionKind.description: Which projection model a camera uses.

oneOf.description: Pinhole (perspective) projection; no parameters of its own.

Equidistant (fisheye) projection: radius = incidence angle, in
radians; no parameters of its own. With
[`DistortionKind::KannalaBrandt4`] it is the Kannala-Brandt fisheye
model.

ReprojectionStats.description:
Summary statistics for reprojection errors.

The percentiles (`median`, `p95`) interpolate linearly between order
statistics of the ascending-sorted errors, the default of numpy and
pandas: the `q`-quantile of `n` errors lies at fractional rank
`q * (n - 1)`, so the median of an even count is the mean of the middle
two. They are present when the statistics were computed from the errors
([`from_errors`](Self::from_errors)), and absent when built from
aggregates ([`from_summary`](Self::from_summary)).

median.description:
Median reprojection error in pixels (the 50th percentile, linearly
interpolated); `None` when built from aggregates. `0.0` for no
errors, as the other statistics.

p95.description:
95th percentile of the reprojection error in pixels, linearly
interpolated; `None` when built from aggregates.

rms.description: Root mean square error in pixels.

SensorKind.description: Which sensor model a camera uses.

oneOf.description: Sensor plane perpendicular to the optical axis; no parameters.

description:
The candidates of [`compare_camera_models`], each scored on held-out
views, and their ranking.

candidates.description:
One score per candidate, in input order: the config's camera first,
then the alternatives.

folds.description:
The held-out view indices of each fold, ascending within a fold.
Every view is in exactly one fold.

ranking.description:
Indices into `candidates` of the comparable ones (scored, with every
held-out point projected), by pooled held-out RMS, lowest first;
ties go to fewer free parameters, then to the earlier candidate.
Empty when no candidate is comparable.
